Frequently Asked Questions

Have questions before upgrading? Here is everything you need to know.

How does Career Hound find direct jobs before LinkedIn? ↓

Rather than relying on public job boards where recruiters pay hundreds of dollars to sponsor listings, our spiders scan employer ATS systems directly (such as Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, and Workday) multiple times a day. You see openings within minutes of an engineering team creating the requisition.

How does the AI Auto-Apply engine work? ↓

You upload your resume and configure target filters (such as roles, salary thresholds, and minimum match score). When a matching job appears with an 80%+ compatibility score, our automated engine formulates tailored responses to custom screening questions, generates an ATS-optimized cover letter, and submits the application directly.

What is Dodo Payments and is my payment secure? ↓

Dodo Payments is our globally licensed Merchant of Record (MoR). All checkout transactions are processed through 256-bit SSL encrypted PCI-DSS compliant gateways. We accept all major credit cards, Apple Pay, and Google Pay worldwide without ever seeing or storing your raw card details.

How does the 7-day money-back guarantee work? ↓

If you do not find Career Hound significantly more productive than applying manually through LinkedIn or Indeed, simply message support@careerhound.io within 7 days of purchase and we will issue a full 100% refund, no questions asked.

Can I cancel my monthly subscription easily? ↓

Yes, anytime with a single click. Go to your Account Dashboard under the Subscription tab and click "Cancel Subscription". You will retain access until the end of your billing cycle with zero penalty.
